MAR.note: A responsible-AI framework is 'taking shape' with no draft published and the minister expects a very light legal framework; no rule or authority stated.

facts.fact: Morocco's AI and digital transition minister told the House of Representatives that the ministry is working on AI assistants, one to help businesses with administrative procedures and a legal assistant for searching legal texts and drafting bills, and that the National Social Support Agency will gradually roll out a chatbot.

By 2026 the General Tax Directorate (DGI) had deployed AI for fraud detection and modules to identify taxpayers not registered for the housing tax and municipal services tax; for 2027 it plans an audit-assistant agent and dynamic taxpayer risk rating.
Moroccan customs relies on predictive analytics to combat fraud, per the article.
AI is in use in two sectors' public systems, tax (DGI fraud detection) and customs (predictive analytics for fraud).
facts.system: DGI AI fraud detection; customs predictive analytics

facts.fact: Morocco's AI models for Darija, Amazigh and Arabic, GemMaroc (language processing) and IsMa (transcription), are developed with an R&D lab established with Mistral AI, and a memorandum of understanding was signed in 2026 with Nexus Core Systems Morocco for a sovereign AI Factory; the document does not say any is released.

MAR.note: Only 'managers' to be trained in AI, not stated to be civil servants; a plan.

facts.fact: The article says a 'Cloud First' directive is intended to make the cloud the default for all new digital projects in government agencies, and that Moroccans' data must be hosted on a sovereign national cloud.

MAR.note: DGSSI named only as a partner in a framework; no body creation, incident or designation stated.
Jazari Root (2027-2029) and Igoudar campus are planned or an agreement; none in service.

facts.fact: The minister said the government's strategic data will be hosted at the planned Jazari Root sovereign data centre (built 2027-2029) and that Moroccans' data must be hosted on a sovereign national cloud, alongside a Cloud First directive for government projects.
facts.system: Jazari Root sovereign data center; Cloud First directive

facts.fact: The minister said the 'AI Made in Morocco' roadmap and the Morocco Digital 2030 strategy remain the framework for his policy.
The strategy is named Morocco Digital 2030.

MAR.note: Only a funding target of 2.5 billion dirhams; no law, labelling or fund stated.
Jazari Institute network is not described as a hub or incubator.
